Nitish Setu Controversy : bihar men ganga nadi par bane kachchi dargah-bidupur 6-len pul ka nam 'nitish setu' rakhe jane aur iske udghatan (PM Narendra Modi Inaugurate Nitish Setu) ko lekar sattapaksh aur vipaksh ke bich tikha siyasi ghamasan chhir gaya hai. pradhanmantri narendr modi dvara 21 navanbar 2026 ko is pul ke udghatan kie jane ke bad rajad neta tejasvi yadav (Tejashwi Yadav) ne purane sarkari dastavej sajha karte hue sarkar ke phaisle par saval uthae hain
